content: कुक्षिः .²1 The belly (in general); जिह्मिताध्मातकुक्षिः (भुजगपतिः) <ls>Mk. 9. 12</ls>. .²2 The womb, the part of the belly containing the foetus; कुम्भीनस्याश्च कुक्षिजः <ls>R. 15. 15</ls>; <ls>Śi. 13. 40</ls>. .²3 The interior of anything; विभक्तात्मा विभुस्तासामेकःकुक्षिष्वनेकधा <ls>R. 10. 65</ls> (where the word is used in sense 2 also.) .²4 A cavity in general. .²5 A cavern, cave; अद्रिकुक्षौ, हैमवताच्च कुक्षेः <ls>R. 2. 38</ls>, <ls n="R. 2.">67</ls>; a valley; अस्तीह हिमवत्कुक्षौ देशः पृथ्वीशिरोमणिः <ls>Ks. 65. 214</ls>. .²6 The sheath of a sword. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Bali. .²8 A bay, gulf.
